previousAttempts.correction: Se fijó Date.now en la prueba de 21 intentos para garantizar una sola ventana temporal. Sin cambios en el control de tasa de producción.
La ampliación del fixture entregaba una propiedad inexistente del Buffer PDF. Se corrigió el dato de prueba y se repitió la suite completa.

protection.scope: por IP, contadores en MongoDB temporal

performance.note: Carga exclusivamente local; generador, API y MongoDB comparten equipo. No mide capacidad de Vercel/Atlas ni usuarios simultáneos.

alerts.name: Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments
alerts.description: The response appears to contain suspicious comments which may help an attacker.
alerts.solution: Remove all comments that return information that may help an attacker and fix any underlying problems they refer to.
alerts.review: La detección de comentarios es informativa y no demuestra por sí sola una contraseña o dato privado expuesto. No se publica la evidencia cruda.

alerts.name: User Agent Fuzzer
alerts.description: Check for differences in response based on fuzzed User Agent (eg. mobile sites, access as a Search Engine Crawler). Compares the response statuscode and the hashcode of the response body with the original response.
alerts.review: Observación informativa; no demuestra una vulnerabilidad explotable.

alerts.name: Modern Web Application
alerts.description: The application appears to be a modern web application. If you need to explore it automatically then the Ajax Spider may well be more effective than the standard one.
alerts.solution: This is an informational alert and so no changes are required.
alerts.review: Observación informativa; no demuestra una vulnerabilidad explotable.

alerts.name: Authentication Request Identified
alerts.description: The given request has been identified as an authentication request. The 'Other Info' field contains a set of key=value lines which identify any relevant fields. If the request is in a context which has an Authentication Method set to "Auto-Detect" then this rule will change the authentication to match the request identified.
alerts.solution: This is an informational alert rather than a vulnerability and so there is nothing to fix.
alerts.review: Observación informativa; no demuestra una vulnerabilidad explotable.
